text.en: Evaluation of chatgpt is row 78 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Evaluation of chatgpt 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 78 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Evaluation of chatgpt with “A multitask, multilingual, multimodal evaluation of chatgpt on reasoning, hallucination, and interactivity”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Evaluation of chatgpt 与论文《A multitask, multilingual, multimodal evaluation of chatgpt on reasoning, hallucination, and interactivity》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Yejin Bang, Pascale Fung”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Yejin Bang（官方页拼写）、Pascale Fung（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Yejin Bang, Pascale Fung”。
